author: "Neudata Consulting Ltd"
client: "Client organisation"
confidentiality: "Confidential"
date: "`r format(Sys.Date(), '%d %B %Y')`"
output:
  quant2qual::neudata_pdf:
    toc: true
params:
  data: ""
  domain: "ux"
  style: "clinical"
---

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
                      fig.align = "center", out.width = "95%")
library(quant2qual)

# Point params$data at a CSV with one row per case. Leave it empty to use the
# simulated cohort shipped with the package.
cases <- if (nzchar(params$data)) {
  utils::read.csv(params$data)
} else {
  mock_behavioral_data(200, domain = params$domain)
}
profile <- identify_archetype(cases, domain = params$domain)
```

# Key findings

```{r findings, results = "asis"}
cn <- generate_cohort_narrative(profile)
cat(cn$sections$overview, "\n\n", cn$sections$friction)
```

# Cohort synthesis

```{r synthesis, results = "asis"}
cat(cn$sections$relationships, "\n\n", cn$sections$confidence)
```

```{r map, fig.width = 7, fig.height = 4.6, fig.cap = "Archetype map"}
plot_archetype_map(profile)
```

```{r signatures, fig.width = 7, fig.height = 3.4, fig.cap = "Archetype signatures"}
plot_archetype_signatures(profile)
```

# Case studies

```{r cases, results = "asis"}
for (id in select_cases(profile)) {
  cat(format(generate_narrative(profile, id, style = params$style), heading_level = 2),
      "\n\n")
}
```

# Methods

Behavior was described on three dimensions (time, activity and friction),
standardised against the cohort and banded at half a standard deviation.
Each case was matched against the `r params$domain` archetype matrix, and its
narrative was assembled by rule-based templating from its own statistics with
quant2qual `r as.character(utils::packageVersion("quant2qual"))`.
